add-foreign-key: Both MinHash tables are new and empty, so their foreign keys validate no existing rows. The referenced entity_versions, entities, workspaces and organization tables take a bounded SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE lock under the 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
row-level-security: Row security is enabled and forced on the two new empty tables before application code can write them.
create-policy: Policies are catalog-only additions to the two new empty tables and run under the migration's one-second lock timeout.
